name: @kindling/sandbox
description: SDK de JavaScript/TypeScript para la API /v1 del gateway de sandboxes de kindling (sin dependencias).

scripts.pretest: node -e "const [a, b] = process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (a < 22 || (a === 22 && b < 18)) { console.error('npm test needs Node >= 22.18 (the tests are .ts files); this is ' + process.versions.node + '. The package itself runs on Node >= 18.'); process.exit(1); }"
